svg.title: Svalbard circuit-block schematic and approximate placement
svg.desc: Explicit RF I and Q mixer, gain, filter and converter paths; PLL feedback loops; wired equalizer, sampler, CDR and serializer; programmable analog tiles; references and host control. All external terminals are at the perimeter. Intended circuits, not a completed transistor schematic.

g.text: Proposed connectivity with RF west, wired east, clocks north and digital south
RF RX — I AND Q ARE SEPARATE CIRCUITS
RF TX — SEPARATE I/Q RECONSTRUCTION AND MIXERS
Idle gates driver bias; detect current senses the output load
Local topology switches; buffered diagnostic mux → shared ADC by ownership
Named clock nets are buffered locally; no global GHz analog crossbar
I/Q queues · capture / playback · update sequencing
SPI · calibration · atomic run / stop · fault / epoch recovery
Wired words / GPIO PHY / clock alignment
Queues · raw/bypass · DDR capture / launch · local HOST_A / HOST_B rails
Symbols: G/A = gain/error amplifier; × = mixer; Σ = sum; ∫ = integration; ± = comparator; D/Q = sampling latch.
Differential pairs use one line; I/Q paths remain separate. Matching RX/TX and clock labels connect nets. No wire crossing implies a connection without a dot.
Intended architecture, not a wired transistor schematic or area proof. Placement is approximate; supplies fan out locally. PA, antenna and protocol/modem logic remain external.
